documents.title: Master services agreement
documents.text:
Master services agreement — Tamsin Partners (fictional).
In this document "TPH" means Tamsin Partners. Tamsin Partners reports term years of 4 years for FY2025 (fiscal year ending 30 June 2025). Tamsin Ltd reports termination notice period of 97 days for FY2025. Tamsin Partners reports approximately liability cap of $3m for FY2024 on a reported basis. Tamsin Partners reports annual fee of $9m for FY2024 on a reported basis. For Tamsin Partners, the renewal is: renews automatically for successive 12-month terms. The fiscal year of Tamsin Partners ends on 30 June.

documents.title: Amendment letter
documents.text:
Amendment letter — Tamsin Partners (fictional).
Tamsin Partners reports term years of 5 years for LTM to 30 Jun 2025. Tamsin AB reports termination notice period of 119 days for FY2025. Tamsin Partners reports annual price escalator of 2.3% for FY2024 on a reported basis. Tamsin Partners reports maximum service credit of 21.2%. For Tamsin Partners, the renewal is: expires at the end of the initial term unless renewed in writing.

documents.title: Supplier summary memo
documents.text:
Supplier summary memo — Tamsin Partners (fictional).
Tamsin Partners reports liability cap of $2.7m for FY2024 on a reported basis. Tamsin Partners reports annual fee of $7.6m for FY2024 on a reported basis. Tamsin Partners reports annual price escalator of 2.7% for FY2024 on a adjusted (management definition) basis. Tamsin Partners reports maximum service credit of 17.5% for FY2024.
